widget_ast.title: Management Concerns and Required Actions

items.title: Completion forecast remains 15 days beyond the baseline project end date
items.narrative: The current schedule analysis reports a forecast completion date of 2027-05-26 against a baseline project end date of 2027-05-11, a reported current project delay of 15 days. The project-wide schedule health shows 118 negative-float activities, 115 critical activities and 155 near-critical activities, with a minimum total float of -14.4 days. The two-week lookahead beginning 2026-09-22 contains 116 activities, of which 110 are starting and 21 are critical.
items.required_action: Review the negative-float and critical activity populations and confirm mitigation ownership for the 110 lookahead activities starting from 2026-09-23.

items.title: 78 engineering transmittals are overdue for submission and 44 returned submissions remain unreturned beyond 14 days

evidence.label: Status C not resubmitted over 14 days

items.narrative: Of 438 total engineering transmittals, 345 were submitted against 423 planned submissions to the data date, leaving 78 overdue not submitted. Material submittals account for the largest overdue share (36 of 172), followed by prequalification (15 of 34) and shop drawings (27 of 232). A further 25 transmittals have been under review for more than 14 days and 44 Status C transmittals have not been resubmitted within 14 days of return, of which 32 are shop drawings.
items.required_action: Escalate the overdue material submittals and prequalifications and enforce resubmission of the 44 open Status C transmittals, with priority on the 32 shop drawings.

items.title: One quality record remains open beyond 14 days
items.narrative: The QA/QC and HSE record set for this snapshot contains 5 documents, of which 2 are open and 3 are closed. One document is open for more than 14 days: NCR-2105-BEC-CVL-0039 (CIV discipline, revision 1), open for 15 days with a response date of 2026-09-23.
items.required_action: Secure the contractor response and closure evidence for NCR-2105-BEC-CVL-0039, due 2026-09-23, before the open-item population grows further.

items.title: Measured progress deficit of 1.3797 pp is recoverable in capacity terms within one month, but remains unverified against CPM and resources

evidence.label: Scenarios classified as full progress recovery

items.narrative: Cumulative planned progress is 19.1186% against cumulative actual progress of 17.7389%, a supplied progress deficit of 1.3797 percentage points. The recovery engine produced 3 scenarios for a 1-month horizon; all 3 are classified as full progress-deficit recovery. The highest-ranked scenario, REC-001 (capacity aware, rank 1), reaches a target recovery date of 2026-10-20 with a residual progress deficit of 0 and peak capacity utilisation of 92.464517%. Its execution feasibility is recorded as conditionally feasible: capacity constraints passed, but CPM delay recovery, resource constraints and workfront constraints are not verified. The reported 15-day schedule delay is therefore not shown as recovered.
items.required_action: Select and resource-load one recovery scenario, confirm workfront and material availability, and re-verify the schedule position through CPM before any completion-delay recovery is reported.

widget_ast.data_qualification: Planned and actual cumulative KPI quantities to the 2026-09-22 data date are supplied for all 25 KPIs, and all 25 KPI definitions match between the planned and actual packages on dgt_kpi, so no planned-to-actual join was dropped. Only Concrete Material (planned 2780, actual 2464 of 5290 total) and Waterproofing Material (planned 5708, actual 5708 of 7476 total) carry a non-zero planned or actual quantity to data date; the other 23 KPIs have a zero cumulative planned quantity to data date because their baseline production starts after this cutoff, so their zero values are baseline timing and must not be read as a performance failure. The calculation packages do not carry per-KPI measurement-unit metadata, and the KPI quantities are heterogeneous (for example volume, area, length and equipment counts), so quantities for different KPIs must not be read against a single shared quantitative axis; the kpi_selector defaults to the two KPIs with quantities to data date and must be used to restrict the plotted set to KPIs that share a comparable scale. variance_actual_minus_planned is a display difference of actual minus planned cumulative quantity within the same KPI, expressed in that KPI's own unit; it is not a normalised or weighted achievement measure and no performance status is assigned.

widget_ast.data_qualification: Variance is the display difference between two supplied cumulative values (cumulative actual minus cumulative planned) to the data date 2026-09-22 (reporting week 18); no new project-controls calculation is introduced. All 25 KPIs present in the planned KPI package were matched to the actual KPI package on dgt_kpi. Only two matched KPIs carry a non-zero cumulative planned or actual quantity to the data date (Concrete Material and Waterproofing Material); the other 23 KPIs record 0 cumulative planned and 0 cumulative actual quantity to the data date, so their variance is 0 and they are not plotted, because a zero value in these supplied packages reflects no planned or earned quantity up to the data date rather than a confirmed zero-performance conclusion. The source packages do not include a measurement-unit field for each KPI: each bar's variance is expressed in that KPI's own measurement unit, and no unit has been asserted in this AST. The two plotted KPIs use different measurement units, so bar lengths must be read per KPI against its own planned quantity and must not be compared directly with one another; cross-KPI magnitude comparison is not authorised. Sign convention is labelled per bar: Concrete Material variance -316 indicates cumulative actual quantity is below cumulative planned quantity to the data date; Waterproofing Material variance 0 indicates cumulative actual equals cumulative planned to the data date. Favourable or adverse performance is not assigned.

No measurement units are supplied in the source packages, so every quantity is presented in the KPI's own measurement basis and quantities must not be aggregated or totalled across rows. Current-period values are the Week 18 reporting period (2026-09-16 to 2026-09-22): all KPI current-period planned quantities are zero as supplied, and only Concrete Material records a current-period actual quantity earned (316).
